p1.tell: The axis starts at $2.10, so an 18-cent rise looks like a rocket. Last September a dozen cost $3.49; this September, $2.27. Eggs are down 35% on the year.
p1.explanation: Real BLS prices, framed to scare. June to October did rise 8%, but the cropped axis makes the October bar five times taller, and the four-month window hides the fall from the $6.23 record in March 2025.
p1.con_line_fooled: Real prices, my axis. I just started it where it hurts.
p1.con_line_caught: You checked the carton. Down 35% on the year. Fine.

p2.explanation: Real and word for word from NPR, and BLS data backs it: butter fell from $4.787 to $3.959 a pound, September to September. Not everything goes up.
p2.con_line_false_alarm: Real. Prices can fall too. Doubting good news is still doubting the truth.

p3.tell: The 18% is over two years. NPR's same sentence says candy rose 7.7% in one year.
p3.explanation: The number is real; its time window was dropped. 'Up more than 18%' reads like this year's damage, but it's two years of increases stacked together. Candy did rise faster than food overall, which is why the claim feels right.
p3.con_line_fooled: I didn't change the number. I just lost the 'in two years.'
p3.con_line_caught: You read the whole sentence. Most people stop at the scary number.

diff.shown: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum are up more than 18%
diff.original: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum have risen 7.7% in one year and are up more than 18% in two years, according to the latest federal data.
diff.missing: The time window: the 18% is over two years. Over one year, candy and gum rose 7.7%.

p4.explanation: Real. Both numbers match BLS average prices exactly, the axis starts at zero, and the account cites its source. Per pound, coffee has out-priced ground beef every month since at least 2022.
p4.con_line_false_alarm: Real, and honestly charted. Absurd isn't the same as false.

p5.explanation: Word for word from NPR. Grocery prices are rising more slowly than in 2022, but on top of a much higher base.
p5.con_line_false_alarm: Real. Not every gloomy quote is a crop.
